item.title: Mike Fabery and Illya Shoykhet volunteered to take part in Le Moyne College ERIE21 sessions (video)
item.description: Earlier this summer our United Radio employees Mike Fabery and Illya Shoykhet volunteered to take part in Le Moyne College ERIE21 sessions. The sessions are part of the MACNY – The Manufacturers Association affiliated Partners for Education & Business, Inc. program. This is a great example of our United Radio core value: “We have a responsibility to each other to create a better community.” Thanks Mike and Illya for your efforts and to MACNY for producing this excellent video!
